verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a dedicated Batch Transfers capability for creating multiple transfers in bulk, covering many beneficiaries, countries and currencies for payroll runs and supplier payments. This delivers a genuine programmatic bulk operation. Card issuing is described as working "at scale," but no bulk endpoint is evidenced for it. Missing for 10: evidenced bulk operations beyond payouts (e.g. bulk card issuance or bulk bill and expense updates), detail on batch limits and partial-failure handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
